items.source:
Execute a handshake request to the given url and handle the resulting
WebSocket session with the given handler.
items.translation: 向给定的 URL 执行握手请求，并使用给定的处理器处理生成的 WebSocket 会话。

items.source: Contract for initiating a WebSocket request. As an alternative considering using the declarative style WebSocketConnectionManager that starts a WebSocket connection to a pre-configured URI when the application starts.
items.translation: 用于发起 WebSocket 请求的合约。作为替代方案，可以考虑使用声明式风格的 WebSocketConnectionManager，该管理器会在应用程序启动时向预配置的 URI 启动 WebSocket 连接。

items.source: a future that completes when the session is available
items.translation: 一个在会话可用时完成的未来

items.source: uriVariables - the variables to expand the template
